• Are you suffering from these symptoms?
  • Effective treatments for aging care
  • Flow of aging care treatment

Are you suffering from these symptoms?

  • Noticeable hollows above the eyes
  • The bear won't go away
  • My skin has lost its firmness
  • The skin around the eyes has become thinner
  • My eyes look older
  • face is dull
  • Wrinkles are becoming more noticeable

Dark circles and hollows around the eyes...the cause of aging

Damage to the skin (irritation/friction)

Damage accumulates on your skin from rubbing your eyes, scratching your eyes, and using too much force when washing your face daily. The skin around the eyes is especially thin, and damage to it can easily manifest as symptoms.

lack of moisture

The eye area naturally has less sebum and is prone to dryness.
When this is combined with age-related decreases in collagen and elastin and exposure to UV rays, wrinkles are more likely to occur.

poor blood circulation

When poor blood circulation occurs due to eye strain, lack of sleep, lack of exercise, etc., dark circles and sunken areas above the eyes are more likely to appear.

Weakness of facial muscles

As facial muscles weaken due to aging, the thin skin around the eyes begins to sag relatively quickly.

Damage caused by UV rays

Although it is not limited to the eyes, damage caused by UV rays can cause aging of the skin.
If the eye area lacks moisture, damage from UV rays will be greater.

Effective treatments for aging care

stem cell therapy

In stem cell therapy, aged stem cells are harvested, processed, and then administered. It is possible to improve symptoms such as fine wrinkles, sagging skin, and dullness. Cell activation promotes collagen production and restores skin function.

stem cell therapy

hyaluronic acid injection

Improves deep wrinkles, scars, and dents. It is a popular treatment because it is fast-acting and safe.

hyaluronic acid injection

botox injection

Effective for expression wrinkles on the forehead, at the corners of the eyes, and between the eyebrows. It is effective by stopping the movement of facial muscles that cause wrinkles.

botox injection

photo facial

It is effective against various skin problems such as age spots, freckles, melasma, redness, acne scars, and enlarged pores. You can experience better results by repeating the treatment several times.

photo facial

Lift up (thread lift)

Special threads are passed under the skin to improve sagging skin. We use threads that are harmless to the human body and will be absorbed into the body over time.

Lift up/thread lift

High (HIFU)

This is a treatment that can improve sagging, make your face smaller, and improve your skin quality without using a scalpel.
By instantly applying ultrasonic waves to high temperatures in areas where you are concerned about sagging, you can achieve a pinpoint lift-up effect.

High (HIFU)

beauty drip

We offer infusions tailored to the patient's wishes, such as high-concentration vitamin C infusions, placenta injections, and NMN infusions.

beauty drip

Flow of aging care treatment

1counseling

Staff or a doctor will provide counseling.
We listen to the patient's concerns and check the condition of their eyes and skin.
We will explain the details of the treatment, and once you agree, we will proceed to the next step.

2face wash

You will be asked to wash your face to remove makeup, sebum, dirt, etc.

3Application of numbing cream

A numbing cream will be applied to the treatment area.

4Injection/infusion start

We provide injections and drips for anti-aging care treatments tailored to each patient.

5Check the affected area

We will check the condition of the affected area and if there are no problems, you can go home.
